speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; tell me, how many days postpartum are you, and have you had any foul-smelling lochia or urinary symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Urinary Tract Infection and ileus. I recommend REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Urinalysis with culture, and Request Images: Pelvic Ultrasound to evaluate for retained products or uterine abnormalities.
